content:
Ana: Quick idea — run a 2-week microexperiment that pairs a small free-credit incentive with a short live webinar + baked-in prompt templates in the welcome flow. Goal = lift 7-day activation and surface prompt template usage. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Ben: Love it. High-level: split inbound 50/50. Variant A = instant credits + CTA to templates. Variant B = invite to 20-min webinar first, then credits in follow-up. Measure activation within 7 days, template usage, and cost per activated user.

Carla: Product constraints — we can auto-issue credits but need a cap per org (suggest $15 equivalent). Also need the prompt-templates landing page URL ready and a webhook for credit issuance. Can have that ready Tue if we prioritize.

Devon: For analytics I'll need clear cohort tags + event names. Proposed params:
```
utm_source=plg_email&utm_campaign=credit_webinar_expt&variant={A|B}
event: signup.completed, activation.first_prompt_run, webinar.registered, webinar.attended
cohort_tag: marketing/credit-webinar-1901234567
```
Also need expected sample size to estimate power.

Erin: I can draft two short email flows + landing copy. Quick subject line options:
- "Get $15 credit + ready-to-use AI prompt templates"
- "Join our 20-min workshop — credits after you attend"
I’ll also create 3 prompt templates for the welcome card (search, summarize, rewrite).

Ben: For power: if baseline 7-day activation is ~8% and we want to detect a +2.5ppt lift with 80% power, rough N per arm ~6k signups. If we do smaller, we should treat as directional and track early signals.

Growth-bot: Campaign "credit-webinar-1901234567" scheduled to start 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC. Calendar invite created: https://calendar.example/credit-webinar-1901234567 :calendar:

Ana: Baseline benchmarks: recent credit drip experiments saw 7-day activation ~8-10% and prompt-template click-thru 12%. If we can hit +2ppt activation and 20% template usage we call it a win. Also want to capture NPS of first prompt usage in follow-up survey.

Devon: I’ll build a dashboard with funnels: signup -> register/credit issued -> first prompt run -> paid conversion (30d). Will tag cohort and set automatic daily refresh. Need final creative links and the landing URL.

Erin: Drafts here: https://docs.example/redwood/marketing/credit-webinar-1901234567 (includes email copy + 3 templates). Feedback welcome :sparkles:

Carla: Confirmed — prompt landing & webhook ready by Tue EOD, credit caps enforced. I’ll own rollout config and can QA the issuance flow.

Ana: Awesome. Next steps: Erin finalize copy by Mon EOD, Carla finish product hooks Tue, Devon onboard tracking + dashboard Tue, Ben & I will confirm audience slice and sample size. Tagging owners: @Erin @Carla @Devon. Go/no-go by Wed 12:00 PT.

Ben: I’ll run a quick sample-size calc with our weekly traffic and confirm numbers by tomorrow.

Devon: Sounds good — I’ll stub the dashboard with placeholder data so we can validate events once hooked up.

Ana: Thanks team — will push a short brief to the launch doc and link here when ready. :raised_hands:
